name: EPIC 220596286

text.card: A red giant 1,329 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.92 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,577 K at its surface.
